title: A Cap in a Hot Sun
lines: Peg digs in a bin, but the cap is not in it.
Peg tips a pot up. The cap is in the pot!
"The sun is hot!" said Tom. Peg nods.
scoring_note: This passage says "it is", "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "it's" or "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
